text: dsh-lan-uuid-fix 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件 bundle，用于让通过局域网纯 HTTP 地址访问的页面继续完成 RPC 初始化。它在 DSH webServer 提供的 index.html 转换钩子中，于应用脚本运行前注入一段 polyfill；当浏览器缺少 crypto.randomUUID 时，使用 crypto.getRandomValues 生成 UUID v4。这样可补齐该浏览器 API 缺失导致的请求 ID 创建失败。适合在局域网 HTTP 环境访问 DSH Web UI 的用户；代码未声明 API 密钥或外部服务依赖。

dsh-lan-uuid-fix helps the DSH Web UI work over plain HTTP on a local network. It injects a polyfill before app scripts run; if crypto.randomUUID is missing, crypto.getRandomValues generates UUID v4 request IDs. No API key or external service is declared.
我想从局域网的 HTTP 地址打开 DSH 网页端，别让 RPC 初始化失败。
浏览器没有 crypto.randomUUID 时，怎么让 DSH Web UI 还能生成请求 ID？
I need the DSH web interface to work from a plain HTTP address on my local network.
dsh-lan-uuid-fix 的功能「局域网 UUID 补齐」：若页面缺少 crypto.randomUUID，就用 crypto.getRandomValues 生成 UUID v4，并在 DSH 应用脚本运行前注入补丁。
dsh-lan-uuid-fix README · dsh-lan-uuid-fix：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin bundle that makes the Web UI work over plain-HTTP LAN addresses.

dsh-lan-uuid-fix README · The bug it fixes：The web client's `mintRpcId()` calls `crypto.randomUUID()`. Browsers only expose that API in **secure contexts** — HTTPS, or loopback. A plain-HTTP LAN origin like `http://192.168.1.66:3080` is not secure, so `crypto.randomUUID` is `undefined`:

| Page origin | Secure context | `crypto.randomUUID` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `http://127.0.0.1:3080` | yes | function |
| `http://192.168.1.66:3080` | **no** | **undefined** |

dsh-lan-uuid-fix README · The bug it fixes：When it's missing, every unary RPC (`host.describe`, `workspace.list`, `session.list`, ...) throws `TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`, the connection generation aborts, the WebSocket streams are killed mid-handshake, and the UI never loads the session/workspace baseline — the workspace browser just shows "No sessions yet" and the console loops `connection lost, retry #N`.

`crypto.getRandomValues` **is** available on insecure origins, so a UUID-v4 backfill fixes it without HTTPS.

dsh-lan-uuid-fix README · How it works：A host plugin registers an **index tap** on `ctx.webServer` (the webserver's html-transform hook, applied to every served `index.html`). The tap injects an inline polyfill that defines `crypto.randomUUID` from `crypto.getRandomValues` when missing, before the app bundles execute. Loopback and HTTPS pages are untouched — the polyfill only activates when the API is absent.

dsh-lan-uuid-fix README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Zenjibad/dsh-lan-uuid-fix
```

The profile patch layer is applied live (HMR), so a running `dsh web` picks it up without a restart. Hard-refresh the page on the remote device afterwards.

The plugin adds one row, `lan-uuid-fix`, which injects `webServer` and taps the index. If your profile previously added this row with a local file path, remove that row before installing the bundle to avoid a duplicate id.

dsh-lan-uuid-fix README · Verify：From the machine serving dsh, or any LAN client:

```sh
curl -s http://<host>:3080/ | grep randomUUID   # polyfill present
```

The workspace browser should list sessions instead of "No sessions yet", and the browser console should show no `connection lost` retry loop.
